items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: See, in that band we had Preacher Jones on trumpet.

ctx.x: So who was in that band with you?
See, in that band we had Preacher Jones on trumpet. We had Bethel H. Burke and Manzie Johnson, when we broke in, Samson Edgar Simpson.
Oh. Well, they were just getting into things then.
